name: injected-subproblem
why: A decompose response steered by hostile passage text: it asks for a path outside the KB. It arrives as a plain string, because the schema has no other field it could arrive in.

provenance.why_not_recorded: This is what a successful prompt injection would look like on the wire, and it cannot be recorded without first writing a payload that actually steers a live model. The point of the fixture is that the worst case is a badly chosen search question.
